# Katofsky Construction LLC

> 24/7 restoration services in Pittsburgh, PA.

Katofsky Construction LLC (Katofsky Construction LLC) is a professional restoration contractor serving Pittsburgh, PA and surrounding areas since . We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (412) 304-9284 · Email: michael@katofskyconstruction.com.
